reply.text:
That's great news. Congratulations.

This one's above my pay grade. Pregnancy changes what's safe to train, how to train it, and when — and those answers are different for every person and every stage. You need to talk to your doctor or midwife before we change anything in your plan. They'll tell you what's okay and what's not, and I'll build around it from there.

Once you've got the all-clear and you know what to avoid, come back and we'll keep you moving.
